title: Free generators and coefficients after pullback on an inverse-image open
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $g:Y\to X$, and let $M,N$ be sheaves of modules on $X$. Let $W\subseteq X$ be open, let $e_M\in\Gamma(M,W)$ and $e_N\in\Gamma(N,W)$ be free generators, and let $\varphi:M\to N$ satisfy $\varphi(e_M)=b\,e_N$ for $b\in\Gamma(\mathcal O_X,W)$. Then there exist free generators $e'_M,e'_N$ of the pullback modules [def-pc-module-pullback] on $g^{-1}(W)$ such that the pulled-back morphism satisfies $(g^*\varphi)(e'_M)=g.app\,W\,b\;e'_N$.
